name: DOC_RAG_REPORT_BENCHMARK_FILTERED
description: DOC_RAG_REPORT_BENCHMARK_FILTERED evaluates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems on their ability to produce accurate, comprehensive reports from document collections. It measures generative quality, factual consistency with retrieved sources, and the relevance of the produced report to the query. The dataset is filtered for evaluation of document-grounded report generation workflows.
evaluation_method: ROUGE / BLEU with complementary human evaluation for factuality
reputation: Niche Hugging Face dataset used for RAG/reporting experiments; limited community adoption compared to major benchmarks.
